mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and a moderate air quality alert with an index of 54.

The City of Verona reminds residents that winter parking regulations begin on November 20, requiring alternate side parking between 1:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m. Additionally, please note the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a packed schedule with Hop Haus trivia, trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and more trivia at Paddy Macs.
In a report from October 23, two thirteen-year-old juveniles were cited for operating prohibited e-motorcycles on Ashton Drive after prior warnings were issued to their families.
Stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day, which is available now while the store is open until 10:00 PM.
